data.title: Coalition Joint Forces Command Requests Civilians Evacuate Hodeidah Port for Their Safety
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson for the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that the Joint Forces Command of the Coalition requests that civilians evacuate the port of Hodeidah—as indicated on the provided map—for their own safety.
    -- SPA
13:52 Local Time 10:52 GMT
0044
